messages:
Nora (eng-sec): quick thread: can we finalize the auth path for cross-project operator actions? short note of decisions pls.
Diego (platform): short problem: operator jobs use single global keys. we want per-project least-privilege without breaking existing infra.
Simran (devx): users care about migration friction. suggest SDK auto-upgrade that swaps keys on first run.
Nora (eng-sec): options: (A) namespaced long-lived keys, (B) bridge that mints short JWTs, (C) full ephemeral minting.
Tess (sre): ops concern: bridge must not be single point of failure. need circuit breaker and emergency fallback to legacy keys.
Diego (platform): tradeoffs: A fastest, B best audit/visibility, C best security but most complex.
Simran (devx): UI: expose per-operator bindings with a simple approve/revoke action. add migration banner and "preview mappings".
Nora (eng-sec): lean: start with namespaced keys + SDK shim, run bridge prototype (canary) that issues short JWTs (1h), then opt-in ephemeral later.
Tess (sre): add metrics: bridge p50/p95, fallback rate, revoke latency. alert if fallback >0.5% for 10m.
infra-bot: noted: RFC follow-up scheduled Fri 09:00; ticket created INF-4201 for bridge PoC (owner: Diego).
Nora (eng-sec): OK locking this plan unless objections. post any blocks here.
